items.answer: Membership is free [1]. To join, come to any Wednesday meeting and add your name to the member list [1].

Rooms for events that start after 17:00 must be booked at least five working days in advance [1]. Rooms for daytime events must be booked at least two working days in advance [1]. All teaching rooms and labs close at 22:00 on weekdays [2]. Events must end and the room must be cleared by 21:45 [2].

Once a month the club runs an Open Build Night for anyone curious [1]. The next one is on Thursday 22 October 2026 at 18:00 in Lab B204 [1]. The Robotics Club's September Open Build Night drew 27 students to Lab B204, close to the room's limit [2]. Teams built line-following robots from starter kits in about ninety minutes [2].

The club meets every Wednesday at 18:00 in Lab B204 [3]. Meetings run for about two hours [3]. The club meets every second Saturday at 11:00, starting from the main entrance [4]. Most meetings are photo walks of two to three hours, so wear comfortable shoes [4].
